question: Can a small observed-input controller remove unwanted common tone from the frozen full-coarse AdaIN50 output on normal crops while retaining its useful dark output, without any further change to its content weights?

credit_and_model_identity.composite: Existing CodeFormer architecture and official initializer, our retained full-coarse fine-tuned restorer, and a new separately trained scalar tone controller

restorer.selection_reason: This exact file is already in the bound2011read-only dependency set; its audited model is identical to historical snapshot50. Load model values only, never resume its optimizer.

reference.role: Untouched CodeFormer behavior reference; not clean illumination or identity truth

input_policy.RGB: Exact retained RGB8 divided by float32 255, shape256x256x3; no enhancement, alignment or regenerated camera pixels
input_policy.support: Existing exact256x256 boolean observed mask; TRAIN full true, comparison cases retain their bound masks
input_policy.empty_or_nonfinite_support: Refuse before model use; no invented replacement pixels

controller.feature_math: For each fixed cell: sum(float64 RGB*mask)/sum(mask) on observed pixels; empty cell RGB=0. Fourth plane=sum(mask)/1024. Cast the resulting4x8x8 grid once tofloat32 and flatten in RGB-plane-then-support-plane row-major order.
controller.feature_helper: One shared CPU NumPy implementation in training and eventual inference; no gradient through this fixed observed-input feature extraction

initialization.first_linear: PyTorch Linear default Kaiming-uniform(a=sqrt(5)); bias uniform(-1/sqrt(256),+1/sqrt(256)), under a scoped saved/restored RNG
initialization.initial_offset: exact zero for every finite feature vector
initialization.initial_composite: Fresh baseRAW is exact historical full-coarse on all pixels. Zero-head compositeRAW matches base on observed pixels and input on unobserved pixels; historical RAW was unprotected outside support. Zero-head PNG matches historical full-coarse PNG on all pixels. Old failed guards remain recorded.
initialization.first_backward: First-layer gradients are connected zeros while final weights are zero. Do not falsely require every parameter to have a nonzero first gradient.

controller.offset_domain_note: ActualFP32tanh can saturate to the endpoints. This fixed scale matches the prior declared scalar-capacity domain; it is not an acceptance threshold, a role classifier, or a selected DEV cutoff.

composite_and_loss.b: Frozen full-coarse CodeFormer delivered RGB256: clip nativeRGB512 to[0,1], then unchanged bilinear512to256 delivery
composite_and_loss.o: Untouched CodeFormer deliveredRGB256 with the same wrapper
composite_and_loss.corrected_RAW: clamp(b+d_phi*ones_RGB,0,1), shape256x256x3; outside observed support restore exact inputRGB for saved compositeRAW and PNG
composite_and_loss.meanY: mean over observed pixels of(0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B), in sRGB units; this is tone control, not physical exposure recovery
composite_and_loss.accumulation: sum of four fresh losses divided by4 before their separate backward calls
composite_and_loss.clamp_gradient: Differentiate through the actual clippedRAW helper; do not substitute d=(target-meanY(b)) or an unclipped/native mean
composite_and_loss.target_computation: Fresh frozen parent forwards for each of200TRAIN observations, ordinary detached float32 tensor copies; compute targets using the same meanY helper as the loss
composite_and_loss.unsafe_inference_tensor_reuse: Frozen forwards may use inference_mode, but cache ordinary CPU arrays and clone/copy outside inference_mode before the controller graph; no unsafe inference-mode tensor saved for backward
composite_and_loss.full_coarse_restoration: Use the historical model that actually trained with full ordinary coarse; do not edit the centered checkpoint formula and resume it
composite_and_loss.other_neural_losses: No new CE/HQ/LPIPS/behavior optimization; existing base learned behavior stays frozen. No additional loss weight is introduced.
composite_and_loss.PNG: floor(clip(correctedRAW,0,1)*255) uint8; restore unobserved pixels from exact original inputRGB8; no display enhancement

training.observation_order: Exact frozen first50 TRAIN selections, four slots/update,200retainedPNG observations/100photographic referenceIDs;100normal and100dark. Roles supervise training only.
training.fresh_TRAIN_definition: Fresh frozen parent forwards, new input-only head features and current head graphs for all200exact retained inputs; no oldgradient/basis use and no cross-platform camera re-render assumption
training.parity_validator_scope: Validate retained data order, roles, inputpixel/source identities only. Old full-training LR/callcaps remain provenance, not controller constraints; do not call the old worker parity validator against this new head recipe.
training.schedule: constant fixed rate for50updates; no warmup, cosine extension, adaptive rate search or retry
training.reason_for_single_rate: A new8257parameter zero-output head learns a bounded scalar directly;1e-3 is a prospective small-head Adam choice, not copied from the millions-parameter fusion recipe or selected by DEV. Success is unproved.
training.precision: FP32, autocast/GradScaler/TF32 disabled; retain and record parent backend flags/runtime/driver; no universal determinism claim

Zero-head compositeRAW compares to base on observed support and input outside; zero-head PNG compares on all pixels. Never swap selected tokens or clean outputs.
prerequisites.fixture1: Exact actual head/helper, pristine zero final layer, fixed finite spatial features and synthetic b=0.4,target=0.45: compare all4parameter gradients to analytic chain; hidden-layer connected zeros are expected.
prerequisites.fixture2: Same actual head/helper, temporarily set finalbias=atanh(0.4) and finalweights=0 so d=0.1; synthetic bRGB=(0.95,0.30,0.10),target=0.60 with three of four pixels observed and distinct protected inputRGB. One observed channel clips above1; compare analytic active-channel clamp/mean/tanh gradients away from a kink and require exact protected input restoration.
prerequisites.gradient_bound: maximum absolute error <=2e-7+2e-5*maximum absolute expected analytic gradient; prospective FP32 numerical check only
prerequisites.retain_actual_and_expected: Export all4gradient arrays per fixture plus inputs/target/means/hiddenactivation/delta/scalars; zero vsNone topology explicit
prerequisites.restoration: Restore head state, Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA RNG, mode and empty.grad status exactly before Adam; all515base/reference tensors and empty gradients remain exact
prerequisites.TRAIN_target_reachability: On each fresh b/target, evaluate achievable mean interval under fixed d limits without new neural calls; an unreachable target is a technical feasibility stop, not permission to expand range or use a clean oracle

evaluation.comparisons: 88cases:40pairedsynthetic+48nativeunpaired; exact observed masks, no native clean-reference metrics

evaluation.root_visual_review: Every406case row and planned exact256sheet, including all48native cases and both known stress outputs; assess tone/chroma/clipping/contrast and unchanged incorrect eyes/expression/glasses/outline. No metric-only acceptance.

limits_of_evidence: The positive scalar-capacity oracle used per-case clean-reference choices. It proves neither these behavioral mean targets nor an observed-input head can select a feasible offset.
The quarterRGB offset range and added clipping can alter edges, chroma, contrast or erase detail. Preclipping scalar form is not structural preservation.
The original and historical full-coarse outputs can contain incorrect facial structure; the new head adds no recovery of geometry, hidden identity, ethnicity or unsupported native detail.
Known normal/dark input-statistic overlap creates an inference ambiguity risk. TRAIN role labels remain training supervision, never deployment inputs or clean-target corrections.
The earlier centered pilot and brightness gate remain failed. This is a new limited model component, not a repaired numerical gate, more epochs, or model/app qualification.

TRAIN support masks are fully observed; partially padded native support features are a distribution shift. All48native cases and padding/feature behavior require independent review, without inventing a mask-coverage acceptance threshold.
